channel.title: Codehimblog – New software listings
channel.description: Codehimblog is an independent directory of free and open-source Windows software. Compare features, check Windows compatibility and find official download sources.

item.title: AgentShot – Audio & Video
item.description: AgentShot is an open‑source AI‑powered video editor that lets you edit footage by speaking commands or pointing at frames, creating new versions for each change.

item.title: Animeko – Audio & Video
item.description: Animeko is a free, open‑source desktop app for tracking, streaming and downloading anime episodes with cloud sync, multiple video sources and subtitle support.

item.title: Aurora – Audio & Video
item.description: Aurora is a free, open‑source music player for Windows that plays local files and streams from many services such as Navidrome, Jellyfin, Plex, YouTube Music, SoundCloud and Spotify.

item.title: Auto-Editor – Audio & Video
item.description: A command‑line tool that automatically trims and edits video and audio files based on silence, volume and motion detection.

item.title: AutoSubSync – Audio & Video
item.description: Automatic subtitle synchronization tool.

item.title: Chromasmith – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: Chromasmith is a free offline photo editor that offers film‑style looks, grain, halation, RAW development and basic retouching tools.

item.title: Ciyue – Productivity & Office
item.description: A cross‑platform dictionary app that can read MDX/MDD, StarDict and ZIM dictionary files.

item.title: Cutlass – Audio & Video
item.description: Cutlass is a free, open‑source video editor that lets you edit footage on a timeline and also offers an AI assistant you can talk to for editing commands.

item.title: FerrumPix – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: FerrumPix is a desktop photo manager and image editor that lets you organize, view, and edit photos on your computer.

item.title: FilmCraft – Audio & Video
item.description: FilmCraft is a free, open‑source non‑linear video editor built in Rust.

item.title: Fly Island – System Utilities
item.description: A lightweight Dynamic Island‑style overlay for Windows that shows instant messages, AI agent status, music controls, clipboard history, file shelf, quick translation and to‑do lists in a collapsible floating panel.

item.title: Frame Player – Audio & Video
item.description: A video player for Windows that plays local files, web links, and torrent streams, with support for casting, subtitle search, and synchronized watching with friends.

item.title: Greycard – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: A professional raw photo editor with accurate color, for Linux, macOS and Windows.

item.title: IPTVnator – Audio & Video
item.description: A free, open‑source IPTV player that lets you watch live TV, movies and series from M3U/M3U8 playlists, Xtream Codes or Stalker portals.

item.title: LightCraft – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: An open-source non‑destructive photo editor written from scratch in pure Rust.

item.title: LightZone – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: LightZone is a professional‑level digital darkroom and photo editor that works with RAW files and offers non‑destructive editing tools.

item.title: LosslessCut – Audio & Video
item.description: A fast, lossless video and audio editor that trims, cuts, merges and remuxes media without re‑encoding.

item.title: Lyrenne – Audio & Video
item.description: A free, open‑source YouTube Music desktop player for Windows.

item.title: Mayfly Go – System Utilities
item.description: A web‑based platform that lets you manage servers, databases, caches, search engines, message queues and containers from a single browser interface.

item.title: Melodia – Audio & Video
item.description: A fast, lightweight cross‑platform desktop music player built with Rust and Slint.

item.title: Meowsic – Audio & Video
item.description: Meowsic is a modern music player for Windows that supports many audio formats and offers playlist and lyric features.

item.title: Nagi – Audio & Video
item.description: A fast, private music player for your local library on Windows, with Navidrome and Jellyfin streaming

item.title: OnlyM – Audio & Video
item.description: Simple Media Player (audio, video and images) for use in meetings.

item.title: Open Photo AI – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: An open source alternative to the popular photo AI editor.

item.title: OpenFilm – Audio & Video
item.description: An open‑source AI video agent that lets a coding agent generate videos and provides a local editor to modify the results.

item.title: PhotoCraft – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: PhotoCraft is an open‑source photo editor written in Rust that aims to provide Photoshop‑like features such as layers, masks, adjustment layers and full PSD support.

item.title: PicasaPy – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: PicasaPy is a free, open‑source photo manager and editor for Windows that works with the same .picasa.ini format as the original Google Picasa.

item.title: Polyphone – Audio & Video
item.description: A free and open-source soundfont editor for creating, editing, and playing musical instrument soundfonts.

item.title: Pylon Player – Audio & Video
item.description: A media player built on VLC that offers a calm interface, music library, subtitle timing tools and visual customizations.

item.title: RAWmakase – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: A fast, non‑destructive RAW photo editor with Lightroom‑style controls for Windows.

item.title: Rembrandt – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: A free photo editor with RAW support, masks and on‑device AI, requiring no account or subscription.

item.title: Riff – Audio & Video
item.description: A free, open-source desktop music player that streams YouTube Music, YouTube, SoundCloud and plays local audio files without ads or accounts.

item.title: Rigby2D – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: Open‑source 2D skeletal animation editor for creating and exporting animations for games and film.

item.title: Rubylight – Games
item.description: Free, open-source game‑streaming host for Windows PCs with AMD Radeon or NVIDIA graphics.

item.title: Scarlet – Audio & Video
item.description: Scarlet is an open-source AI video editor for macOS, Windows and Linux.

item.title: Screenbox – Audio & Video
item.description: LibVLC-based media player for the Universal Windows Platform

item.title: Servo – Developer Tools
item.description: Servo is an experimental web browser engine written in Rust that can run web pages and be used for testing web technologies on Windows.

item.title: Skrin – Audio & Video
item.description: A free, open‑source local media library and video player that organizes movies and TV shows on your computer or NAS without a server or account.

item.title: Spacewave – Productivity & Office
item.description: Spacewave is a self‑hosted, browser‑based workspace that runs locally without any server, offering encrypted peer‑to‑peer sync and collaborative spaces for files, notes, apps and more.

item.title: Tauon – Audio & Video
item.description: Tauon is a powerful and streamlined music player for the desktop.

item.title: VLC Media Player Redesign – Audio & Video
item.description: An unofficial build of VLC 4 that keeps the original VLC engine and codecs but replaces the interface with a new design by Juxtopposed.

item.title: VLC Win10smtc – Audio & Video
item.description: A plugin that adds Windows System Media Transport Controls integration to VLC Media Player.

item.title: WaveFlow – Audio & Video
item.description: WaveFlow is a local‑first music player that organizes and plays the audio files you already own, with high‑resolution playback, word‑synced lyrics and customizable skins.

item.title: Waves – Audio & Video
item.description: A keyboard‑driven terminal music player that lets you browse, play, tag and download music, with support for Soulseek, MusicBrainz, Last.fm and radio mode.

item.title: WeftCut – Audio & Video
item.description: Free, open-source AI‑driven video editor that lets an AI agent control the timeline just like a human user.

item.title: WinRAR Keygen – System Utilities
item.description: A tool that generates WinRAR license files (rarreg.key) for use with the WinRAR archiver.

item.title: AeroZoom – System Utilities
item.description: Keyboard‑free screen magnifier for Windows that lets you zoom with the mouse wheel or pinch gestures and provides a panel for presentation‑style controls.

item.title: AF Media Bar – Audio & Video
item.description: A taskbar media controller that shows media information, lyrics and playback controls directly on the desktop.

item.title: AppGroup – System Utilities
item.description: App Group lets you organize, customize, and launch your apps.

item.title: Astraeus – System Utilities
item.description: A native Windows dashboard that slides out from the edge of the screen, providing quick access to media, system controls and widgets.
